_comment: Nano Banana (Gemini image) prompts for the split-test-v2 'Plumbera' LP. Generate one set PER CLIENT, save under sites/{slug}/public/images/lp/, then wire the two URLs into the manifest entry (heroImageUrl = technician portrait, featureImageUrl = team photo). Use model 'pro'. People-focused imagery (not flood scenes) — this design leans on a friendly-technician trust angle. The hero box crops with object-top, so frame faces in the upper-center with headroom. Adjust nouns for the client's niche.

images.prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a friendly professional male restoration technician, short hair, clean navy uniform shirt and cap, smiling warmly at the camera, standing in a bright living room holding a moisture meter, his full head and face clearly visible with comfortable empty space above his head, framed from mid-thigh up, centered composition, soft natural lighting, approachable and trustworthy, no text, no logos, professional commercial photography.

Photorealistic photo of two professional male restoration technicians in matching navy uniforms working together in a residential home, one operating a commercial dehumidifier and the other holding a clipboard, drying equipment and air movers around them, plastic containment sheeting on furniture, friendly and competent, natural lighting, landscape composition, no text, no logos, professional commercial photography.
